_doc: Headset patient flow (Phase 2) and presentation options (Phase 5). Read by headset/Perimetry.Headset.Logic, part of the config hash. Training levels are device dB (0 = device maximum). Field positions in degrees, OD convention (mirrored for OS).

fixationTarget._colorDoc: HFA central fixation target is yellow; rendered at the luminance below, independent of the stimulus scale.
fixationTarget._diamondDoc: Foveal test (Phase 5): the four dots of the Diamond4 target (strategies.json foveal.diamondHalfSizeDeg from the centre) have this diameter, same colour and luminance as the central target.

lockAnimation._doc: Oculokinetic mode B (Phase 5): after the target jumps it is drawn startScale times larger and startLuminanceFactor times dimmer, settling linearly to the normal target over the lock phase (reliability.json oculokinetic.lockDelayMs, or until gaze is confirmed).

training._doc: 3-5 practice presentations with feedback (SPEC §8). stimulusShown=false is a blank trial that teaches not to press without a light. Training responses are logged but never enter the exam.

checks._doc: Pre-exam verification (SPEC §8.2). Button: the welcome screen only advances on a press. Sharpness: the patient confirms the fixation target is sharp (IPD/focus reminder). Occlusion (optional, off by default, product owner 2026-10-18: the headset already blocks outside light well): during the exam the untested eye always receives black and both eyes stay open; this short check before each eye makes the patient close the tested eye for occlusionWindowMs while a bright disc is shown to the tested eye only, and a press means light reaches the untested eye (stop, call the doctor).

_presetsDoc: Phase 5: fovealThreshold (default false), responseMode YesNo|ForcedChoice (default YesNo) and fixationMode Oculokinetic/CentralEyeTracking are options; the first preset stays the default exam. 30-2 reaches 27° (38° on the diagonal): inside the Quest 3 field of view (about 55° horizontal / 48° vertical half-angles) but close to the lens edge, where sharpness drops; verify on the device.
_ageDoc: Used only when no exam order file provides the age; the operator adjusts it on the setup screen. Age drives the ZEST prior and the normative comparison.

presentation._doc: Rendering details outside the psychophysics. fallbackIpdMm is used only when the runtime gives no eye positions (desktop preview); it is logged. Text is dark grey on the background, below the fixation target: its top edge messageOffsetDeg below the target, each line messageLineHeightDeg high as seen by the patient, sentences word-wrapped so no line is wider than messageMaxWidthDeg (lens sharpness falls off-centre). Product owner 2026-10-20: larger text, closer to the target.

sync._doc: Phase 4: optional link to the doctor portal (docs/SYNC_API.md). The exam never depends on it: files are written locally first and sent later; without portal.json / portal-token.json on the headset the flow is the Phase 2 one. liveIntervalMs is the maximum gap between live snapshots; retryBackoffMs is applied in order after consecutive network failures, then the last value repeats.

oculokinetic._doc: Phase 5, headset side of mode B. With eye tracking the stimulus waits for gaze within gazeConfirmDeg for gazeConfirmMs (reliability.json); if that never happens the lock ends after lockDelayMs * gazeConfirmTimeoutFactor and the presentation goes on (the gaze rule at onset then rejects it if the eye is still away). gazeStaleMs: gaze counts as unavailable when no sample arrived for this long (Quest 3 has no eye tracker: always unavailable).
